documents.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine's public buses leave 30 dead as blackouts worsen in Kyiv
documents.lead: A Russian guided bomb exploded beside passenger buses in Kramatorsk, killing 30 people, authorities said. Officials suspended public transport in Kramatorsk and Sloviansk.

documents.title: Russian strike kills at least 33 in eastern Ukraine in deadliest single attack this year
documents.lead: At least 33 people were killed when a Russian strike caused two public buses to catch fire in Kramatorsk, officials said. Police said Russian drones targeted officers who were helping victims of the strike.

documents.title: 30 Killed in Russian Air Strike on Civilian Bus Stop
documents.lead: A Russian air strike beside a bus stop in Kramatorsk killed 30 people, authorities said.
